summary.method: Recomputed from runs[].summary[].lanes[].all (the per-round samples, in round order): ratio_i = lane_i / base_i with base the first lane of the run; median_ratio, min_ratio and max_ratio are over those per-round ratios; noise_band_max_over_min is max/min of a lane's own samples. Each recomputed median ratio was compared with the vs_base the harness stored; the largest difference is in recomputed_vs_stored_max_abs_diff.
